parameters.query:
SELECT
  doctor_id,
  doctor_name,
  specialization,
  department,
  consultation_duration,
  available_from,
  available_to
FROM doctors
WHERE is_active = TRUE
AND (
  department LIKE CONCAT('%', '{{ $json.department }}', '%')
  OR specialization LIKE CONCAT('%', '{{ $json.department }}', '%')
)
ORDER BY doctor_name ASC;
